{{Quote|When you have the glowfish on the hook, don't talk it to death. Just beat it over the head with a big club.|Old [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] saying|<ref name="TFO">{{JournalCite|15|Two for One}}</ref>}}
'''Glowfish''' were an [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They had the ability to generate light.<ref name="SoA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shards of Alderaan]]''</ref> Glowfish were also known to the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], who had a saying about them.<ref name="TFO" />
